## Checklist

- [ ] The entry follows the format: `* [Library Name](URL) - Description.`
- [ ] The description ends with a full stop/period.
- [ ] The description is short, simple and unbiased (no buzzwords or marketing jargon).
- [ ] I have searched for previous entries before suggesting this one to avoid duplicates.
- [ ] The link is correct and the project is actively maintained (PHP 5.5+, Composer-installable preferred).
